name: kingshot-tools
description: Research Kingshot events, generate reproducible event-pack CP reports, query packs, and calculate CP value.

interface.shortDescription: Research events and generate reproducible pack CP reports.
interface.longDescription: Research Kingshot event rules, gameplay, milestones, schedules, and strategies; verify the player's server-progression variant plus exact pack and reward contents; then generate reproducible Markdown reports with activity-specific models, pack CP, marginal value, sensitivity analysis, and milestone purchase optimization.
defaultPrompt: 查詢 Kingshot 活動的玩法、計分、里程碑與時程。
先確認伺服器進度、禮包與獎品內容，再為這個 Kingshot 活動產生可重算的 CP 報告。
查詢 Kingshot 禮包的價格與內容。
計算這個 Kingshot 禮包的 CP 值。
